feeds.title: Internet & Social Media Law Blog
feeds.description: The Internet & Social Media Law Blog addresses legal issues surrounding the latest technological developments and social media trends. Blog contributors help companies establish and maintain an online presence, optimize business opportunities, overcome hurdles and mitigate risk.

feeds.title: Social Media Law Bulletin
feeds.description: Our Social Media Law Bulletin will update counsel and business leaders of regulatory, employment, litigation and intellectual property developments that arise with social media. With topics of a global range, addressing privacy and security, social media policies, branding and defamation, our blog will provide some practical tips to help you keep up with social media issues that matter to business.

feeds.title: CIPIT Blog » Social Media and the Law
feeds.description: CIPIT's award-winning blog is the first law faculty blog of its kind in East and Central Africa. CIPIT is a part of Strathmore Law School and is an innovative center for evidence-based research and training in intellectual property and information technology law and policy.

feeds.title: Trending Law Blog
feeds.description: Exploring the Impact of Social Media on the Law. Trending Law Blog is published by Saiber LLC, a business counseling and litigation law firm headquartered in Florham Park, NJ. Rob Nussbaum has lectured numerous times on legal issues and social media and how social media and other electronic evidence may be admitted into evidence at trial.

feeds.title: Socially Aware Blog
feeds.description: Social media is generating new legal questions at a far faster pace than the law's ability to provide answers to such questions. Here at Morrison & Foerster, across all of our practice groups, we are seeing complex, cutting-edge legal issues arising out of social media. Morrison & Foerster's published blog devoted to the law and business of social media.
